_help: Fill in a retailer once you're approved by its affiliate program, then commit. The site updates itself. Leave a value empty to send shoppers to the retailer without tracking. 'amazon_tag': your Amazon Associates tracking ID. 'template': your network tracking link with {url} where the product URL goes, e.g. a Commission Factory link like https://t.cfjump.com/12345/t/67890?Url={url}
disclosure: Some links on Strikethrough are affiliate links, so we may earn a commission if you buy. It never changes a verdict or a score.
